entries.rationale: structural: the CLI entry point runs only in the launcher process, which no spec drives, so every one of its mutants is reported uncovered instead of detected
structural: the mutation orchestration runs only in the launcher process, which no spec drives, so every one of its mutants is reported uncovered instead of detected
structural: the trial dispatcher runs only in the launcher process, which no spec drives, so every one of its mutants is reported uncovered instead of detected
structural: the worker bootstrap runs before its own loader hook can splice a mutant in and before coverage starts, so its mutants come back not applied or uncovered, never detected
debt: mutants of its timeout handling hang until the trial timeout, and the rest survive for want of specs on the stream and exit handling
debt: mutants of its dispatch loop hang until the trial timeout, and the rest survive for want of a spec on the scheduling itself
debt: its hook ordering, pending signalling and timing have no direct spec, so those mutants survive; they are reachable from a worker
